narrative.overview: Indexed-document site: ink, paper and tint grounds, lavender as the single live accent, the multicolour logo as the only spectrum, flat surfaces, one house ease.
keyCharacteristics: Three section grounds; header follows data-theme
700 sans for reading, 300 mono for data

rules.name: The Ink-Paper-Tint Rule
rules.body: A section is exactly one of dark, paper or tint, declared through data-theme.

rules.name: The Logo Owns The Spectrum Rule
rules.body: Only lavender among logo colours does UI work; logo-red is the error colour.

rules.name: The Opacity Contrast Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is 60-70% of the ground colour; do not go below the recorded floors.

rules.name: The Heavy-Light Pairing Rule
rules.body: 700 sans for reading, 300 mono uppercase for data.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift; state change is colour, translate or opacity.

dos: Do express every size, gap and radius in --u multiples.
Do use SectionShell and data-theme for every indexed section.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, glow or blur.
Don't use non-lavender logo colours outside the logo.
